name: Signature Robe (Drakniya)
description: a floor-length ceremonial druid-robe of layered {{PRIMARY}} and {{ACCENT_SOFT}} silk cut into overlapping leaf shapes, wide bell sleeves, a mantle of living ivy and small flowers over the shoulders, an open front over a fitted {{PRIMARY}} bodice and long slit skirt, a woven {{METAL}} belt hung with seed-pods and small bells, a trailing hem of fern fronds
notes: Ceremonial signature robe in her element and class, worn in her Robe scene.
